# **ALOHA FRIDAYS AT KAPALUA RETURNS AUG. 28 WITH LIVE MUSIC, LOCAL FOOD VENDORS AND MORE**


*Free quarterly event hosted by Maui Land & Pineapple Company at The Barn in Kapalua brings community together to celebrate Maui’s entrepreneurs*


26/08/2026


**KAPALUA** – Aloha Fridays at Kapalua, the quarterly community gathering hosted by Maui Land & Pineapple Company, Inc. (NYSE: MLP), returns on Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, from 6 to 9 p.m. at The Barn in Kapalua. The free, family-friendly event brings together live music, local food vendors, residents and visitors for an evening celebrating community and the creative spirit of West Maui.


> “Aloha Fridays at Kapalua is about celebrating the local businesses and musicians who help make West Maui vibrant and creating a welcoming space for local families and visitors to discover something new, spend time together and experience the best of what our community has to offer,” said **Oralani Koa, Director of Cultural and Community Engagement for Maui Land & Pineapple Company.**


The evening will feature a full lineup of live music and hula, including Nā Pua O Kapi‘olani Hula Studio, Kumu Hula Kathy Ho‘okaumoku Balar, Ka Papa Hula O Lahainaluna, Kumu Eva Palakiko, Josh Kahula & Dani Girl and Mele Pono featuring the Akima ‘Ohana.


Guests can also shop and enjoy offerings from more than a dozen local makers and vendors including, ‘Awa Delites, Dirty Dragon Soda, Fiyah Foods, HI Darling Shop, Honi Designs Hawaii, Jyla Rose Co., Noelani Designs, ‘Ono Loa Grindz, Penne Pasta, Plant Gypsesa, Pueo Mana Designs, Subinonos Bakery and Viki’s Cominda Mexicana.


The next Aloha Fridays at Kapalua will be held Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, at The Barn in Kapalua. For more information, visit[mauiland.com](http://mauiland.com/) .


**Event Details:**


**What:** Aloha Fridays at Kapalua


**When:** Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, from 6 to 9 p.m.


**Where:** The Barn, 1000 Kapalua Drive, Lāhainā, HI 96761


**Entertainment:** ​ Nā Pua O Kapi‘olani Hula Studio, Kumu Hula Kathy Ho‘okaumoku Balar, Ka Papa Hula O Lahainaluna, Kumu Eva Palakiko, Josh Kahula & Dani Girl and Mele Pono featuring the Akima ‘Ohana.


**Food Vendors:** Awa Delites, Dirty Dragon Soda, Fiyah Foods, HI Darling Shop, Honi Designs Hawaii, Jyla Rose Co., Noelani Designs, ‘Ono Loa Grindz, Penne Pasta, Plant Gypsesa, Pueo Mana Designs, Subinonos Bakery and Viki’s Cominda Mexicana.


**Admission:** Free to the public

**About Maui Land & Pineapple Company**


Maui Land & Pineapple Company, Inc. (NYSE: MLP) is dedicated to the thoughtful stewardship of its portfolio, including over 22,000 acres of land and 247,000 square feet of commercial real estate. The Company envisions a future where people can thrive in resilient communities with sufficient housing supply, economic stability, food and water security and deep connections between people and place. For over a century, the Company has built a legacy of thoughtful stewardship through conservation, agriculture, community building and land management. The Company continues this legacy today with a mission to thoughtfully maximize the productive use of its assets to meet the current critical needs and those of future generations.
